t: Titan TTB892MLT 240V electric multi-tool designed for versatile cutting, sanding, and scraping tasks in workshops and on-site. Features a powerful 300W motor and 6-speed variable control to deliver efficient performance for various materials, making it ideal for plumbers, electricians, and general builders tackling intricate installations or renovation projects. The oscillating cutting action allows precise operation, and the Starlock quick-release blade change, ensures rapid accessory swaps. An air-cooled motor and robust aluminium gearbox provide durability, while the soft-grip handle enhances user comfort and control during prolonged use. Compact and lightweight design with 2.5m cable for extended reach and flexible use. Supplied in a blow-moulded case to keep the tool and extensive accessories organised, whilst allowing for convenient transport and storage. Includes blades, scraper and sanding sheets.
